items.evidence: Valid apiLevel 2.13 and metadata; all volumes (1-5 uL, 8 uL mix) are handled by the p20 within range, and the 10 uL wells are never overfilled. All measured checks pass.
Every step does pick_up_tip/drop_tip per well, including a fresh tip for each primer pair and colony. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks pass.

The protocol adds steps the paper does not have (mix and touch_tip). It also invents assumptions about primer Tm and concentration, and it describes an 'ice-chilled deck' that the code does not provide. Cycling uses a combined 72 C anneal/extend with a '4-10 C' hold instead of the paper-based adjusted program.
10 uL reaction: 5 uL Q5 2x master mix is dispensed first, then 4 uL primer pair, then 1 uL colony template.
colony_plate.wells(), primer_plate.wells() and pcr_plate.wells() are zipped in order, so all 96 wells map A1 to A1 with none skipped or reused.

Sealing and cycling are recorded only in a final comment. The program is a two-step 98/72 C cycle with no separate annealing step. It rests on an invented assumption (Tm >= 69 C) and ends with a '4-10 C' hold rather than 4 C.

judge.summary: The liquid handling is sound. It uses fresh tips throughout, builds correct 10 uL reactions in the right order, and maps wells 1:1 across all 96. It loses the fidelity and thermocycling items because of invented assumptions (primer Tm, primer concentration, ice-chilled deck), extra mixing and touch-tip steps, and a non-standard two-step cycling program with a 4-10 C hold.
